info.title: TypeSafe
info.description: Ask yes/no questions, evaluate statements, select choices, or assign ratings to your content. Send your API key in the Authorization header as `Bearer <API_KEY>`. Use GET /v1/models to discover available model names.

post.description:
Answer one or more questions about the content supplied in `state`.

You can mix question types in one request. Answers use the same names as the
questions, so you can match each result to its question. The response also includes
the model used and token usage.

get.description:
List the models and aliases available to the authenticated account.

Pass a returned model name as `model` in a POST /v1/systemone request.

Answer.description: An answer whose type matches the corresponding question.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a selection from the requested choices.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The name of the choice with the highest probability among the question's criteria.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in the selected choice, from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate greater certainty; use lower values to flag uncertain selections for review.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Probability of each choice in criteria, keyed by choice name, from 0 to 1. Shows how likely the alternatives are; values sum to approximately 1.

ChoiceAnswer.title: ChoiceAnswer
ChoiceAnswer.description: The selected choice, confidence, and probabilities for a choice question.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a question that selects one of the choices in criteria.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: What the model should decide when choosing an option.
examples: What is the tone of this message?

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Choice names and descriptions of when each applies. A choice without a description is interpreted by its name alone.

ChoiceQuestion.title: ChoiceQuestion
ChoiceQuestion.description: A question that selects one option from the choices you define.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Validation errors describing which request values are missing or invalid.

HTTPValidationError.title: HTTPValidationError
HTTPValidationError.description: Request validation failures returned with HTTP status 422.

name.title: Name
name.description: Model name or alias accepted by the request's model field.

description.title: Description
description.description: Human-readable description of the model and its capabilities.

release_date.title: Release Date
release_date.description: Model release date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

ModelMetadata.title: ModelMetadata
ModelMetadata.description: A model or model alias available to the authenticated account.

models.title: Models
models.description: Available models and aliases. Use a model's name in POST /v1/systemone requests.

ModelMetadataList.title: ModelMetadataList
ModelMetadataList.description: Models and aliases available to the authenticated account.

noul.title: Noul
noul.description: Probability of a yes answer or a true statement, from 0 to 1. Values near 1 favor yes or true, values near 0 favor no or false, and values near 0.5 indicate uncertainty.

NoulAnswer.title: NoulAnswer
NoulAnswer.description: The probability of a yes answer or a true statement.

true.title: True
true.description: What counts as a yes answer.

false.title: False
false.description: What counts as a no answer.
examples: The message is a legitimate conversation.

NoulCriteria.title: NoulCriteria
NoulCriteria.description: Criteria defining what counts as a yes or no answer.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a yes/no question or statement.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The yes/no question or statement to evaluate.

criteria.description: Criteria clarifying what counts as a yes or no answer.

NoulQuestion.title: NoulQuestion
NoulQuestion.description: A yes/no question or statement, answered with the probability of yes or true.

Question.description: A question about the supplied content.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a rating against the requested score levels.

score.title: Score
score.description: Expected score: the probability-weighted average of the rubric levels. May fall between integer levels.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in the score, from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate greater certainty; use lower values to flag uncertain ratings for review.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: The requested criteria mapped to their score levels, so you can interpret the score.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Probability of each score level, from 0 to 1, using the same keys as legend. Shows how likely the alternatives are; values sum to approximately 1.

ScoreAnswer.title: ScoreAnswer
ScoreAnswer.description: An expected score with its rubric, confidence, and score-level probabilities.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a question that rates the content using the levels in criteria.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Ordered descriptions of the score levels. Each description's position determines its score, starting at zero.

ScoreQuestion.title: ScoreQuestion
ScoreQuestion.description: A question that assigns a score using an ordered rubric.

state.title: State
state.description: The content all questions in this request refer to.
examples: I was charged twice. Please help.

model.title: Model
model.description: Name or alias of the model to use. Available names are returned by GET /v1/models.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Questions to ask about the content, each with a name you choose. The response uses those names to identify the answers.

SystemOneRequest.title: SystemOneRequest
SystemOneRequest.description: Content and named questions to evaluate together using a TypeSafe model.

model.title: Model
model.description: Name of the model that answered the questions. May differ from the alias supplied in the request.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Answers keyed by the question names supplied in the request. Each answer's type matches its question's type.

usage.description: Input and output token counts for this evaluation.

SystemOneResponse.title: SystemOneResponse
SystemOneResponse.description: Answers grouped by question name, with the model used and token usage.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Number of billable input tokens used to evaluate the request.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens used to answer the questions. Output tokens are currently free of charge.

loc.title: Location
loc.description: Path to the invalid value: the request location followed by field names and array indices.

msg.title: Message
msg.description: Human-readable explanation of the validation failure.

input.title: Input
input.description: The input value that failed validation.

ctx.title: Context
ctx.description: Additional context used to explain the validation failure.

ValidationError.title: ValidationError
ValidationError.description: A request validation error at a specific field or array element.
